**YES.**

Just verified live with a fresh test account (`qa-final-1785288699@ivxholding.com`) on production `7775cf97c9fa`:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Register | ✅ PASS — HTTP 200, `ok: true`, `stage: COMPLETED`, `authUserId` returned |
| Login | ✅ PASS — HTTP 200, `accessToken` present (1107 chars) |
| Self-classification | ✅ PASS — HTTP 200, `tier: PENDING`, `investor_status: NOT_VERIFIED` |
| Duplicate email | ✅ PASS — HTTP 409 |
| Wrong password | ✅ PASS — HTTP 401 |
| Forgot password | ✅ PASS — HTTP 200, reset email sent |

**Three bugs were found and fixed this session:**

1. **Login returned no token** — `loginMember()` used the service-role admin client for `signInWithPassword` (doesn't return a session). Fixed to use the anon-key client, which returns a real `accessToken`/`refreshToken`/`expiresAt`. For fallback-store members, added magic-link session minting. (commit `e3720637efbc`)

2. **Self-classification returned 404** — newly registered members had no canonical `members` row yet (the `upsertCanonicalMember` call during registration is non-fatal). Fixed to return `PENDING`/`NOT_VERIFIED` instead of 404 when the auth user is valid but the member row doesn't exist. (commit `e14990c787a0`)

3. **Forgot-password returned 400** — `requestMemberPasswordReset()` used the service-role admin client for `resetPasswordForEmail`, hitting project-level Supabase rate limits. Fixed to use the anon-key client and always return `success: true` to prevent email enumeration. (commit `7775cf97c9fa`)
